Retrieves all users who are part of this group.

endpoints.title: Edit Thread
endpoints.description: Rename, archive, reopen or tag a thread: its owner or anyone who can manage messages. Locking (only moderators write) needs Manage Messages.

verification.test: threads: start with a card, list, rename, archive

endpoints.title: Threads Of A Channel
endpoints.description: Active threads (or archived ones with `archived=true`), newest first, 50 per page (`limit` up to 100); `before` is a thread id.

verification.test: threads: start with a card, list, rename, archive

endpoints.title: Start Thread
endpoints.description: Start a thread in a text channel, from a message or with a first message, or a post in a forum (a title, a first message and its tags). Needs Send Messages in the channel, and Create Threads (Create Forum Posts in a forum). Refused with `ThreadsDisabled` or `ForumsDisabled` when the server has them switched off.
restrictions: The first message (content, up to 2000 characters) is sent like any message of the bot: Send Messages and the mention rules apply, and if it is refused no thread is made. It takes no embeds, components or attachments yet; send those in a second message.

verification.test: threads: start with a card, list, rename, archive
